description_en: Unbinds the external identity provider from a specified workspace and cleans up users synchronized by that identity provider. The unbinding is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can track the progress by querying the status through GetIdentityProvider
description_zh: 解绑指定工作空间的外部身份提供商，并清理由该身份提供商同步产生的用户。解绑为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展
name: DeleteIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider to unbind. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu. The value must match the currently bound type
parameters.help_zh: 待解绑的外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu，取值必须与当前绑定的类型一致
parameters.name: identity_provider_type
